mapping.summary: Automates emailing, securing and tracking of outgoing BC documents with templates
claims: Email signatures can be set to apply only for a limited period, e.g. seasonal greetings
Fields from posted documents can be inserted into the email body
Emails are sent by a background process so users are not blocked
PDF attachments can be digitally signed or password protected
Supports eIDAS-compliant eSeal certificates on PDFs
Email jobs pick up new documents automatically and queue them for sending
Works with standard Report Selection and preconfigured email templates
Picks the email template variant automatically from attributes like customer type or language
AI translation helps create email templates in several languages
Gives an overview of sent and draft documents
AL Extension Builder adds the email and distribution features to custom or standard pages
Activation goes through the customer's Dynamics partner
